name: Lillymon (X Antibody)
main_effect: [When Digivolving] If there's a suspended Digimon, gain 1 memory. If [Lillymon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) for each of your opponent's suspended Digimon.
source_effect: [Your Turn] This Digimon gets +1000 DP for each of your opponent's suspended Digimon.
